correctness.rationale: The polytope Gauss criterion says d works at a vertex iff all incident outward facet normals have strictly one sign on d. T tetra vertex-radius lines work and weak-neighborly antipodal lower bound forces four. C each non-coordinate-zero line sees only one antipodal vertex pair, so four body diagonals are sharp. O axes cover six signed-coordinate vertices. D exact golden-ratio model has 20 vertices, 12 pentagonal normal facets; (1,1,0),(1,−1,0),(0,0,1) strictly separate every vertex cone. I has 12 vertices and 20 triangular normal facets; three coordinate axes cover all. Universal dimension lower bound X≥3 completes O,D,I. Exact Q(√5) verifier reconstructs facets, edges and all cone tests.
